messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — HIGH impact: ALB healthchecks failing for Greenfield Labs (private VPC). 90% of targets UNHEALTHY. Affects dedicated pool gf-dedicated-1. Error pattern: 502/403 from origin. Paging oncall.
jamie_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing context. @sam_netops can you join? I'll open a handoff channel with customer success.
sam_netops: on it. pulling ALB target health and SG history now. suspect SG tightening change last night.
olivia: I can reach the private gateway. quick check: `curl -sS -I http://10.4.12.8/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` from the origin host.
sam_netops: output from describe-target-health looks like targets draining. also checking SG rules:
```
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0abc1234 --query 'SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions'
# result: only 10.0.0.0/24 allowed on :80, no 10.1.x entries
```
sam_netops: I see PR #452 merged yesterday that narrowed ingress from 10.1.0.0/16 -> 10.0.0.0/24 (security hardening). ALB healthcheck source IPs are in 10.1.2.0/24, so healthchecks are blocked.
elaine_prod: Customer impact: Greenfield Labs synchronous inference endpoints returning 502 to clients. We are seeing spike in error rate and some request retries. ETA on mitigation?
devex-ops: Quick mitigations (pick one):
- add a temporary SG ingress allowing ALB healthcheck CIDR (10.1.2.0/24) -> fastest
- change healthcheck source via ALB config (slow, requires maintenance window)
- failover to NLB passthrough if available (not trivial for this private deploy)
jamie_oncall: let's do the temporary SG allow first to restore customer traffic, then RCA & rollback. I'll apply and monitor.
jamie_oncall: applying temporary rule now (annotating for audit). @sam_netops can you verify afterwards?
sam_netops: please run this command from the admin host (I have creds):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress \
  --group-id sg-0abc1234 \
  --ip-permissions IpProtocol=tcp,FromPort=80,ToPort=80,IpRanges='[{"CidrIp":"10.1.2.0/24","Description":"temp-allow-alb-hc"}]'
```
olivia: running curl after rule add...
olivia: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` — health endpoint returning 200 now. Targets show healthy -> 100%.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ALB target health recovered to 100% (45s after SG change). Traffic back to normal for gf-dedicated-1.
jason_custsuccess: notified Greenfield Labs via email and support channel. They confirm reduced errors. Asking for timeline for permanent fix and audit log.
jamie_oncall: creating incident ticket INS-2026-121 and assigning to @sam_netops + @olivia for RCA + remediation (re-evaluate PR #452, update healthcheck IPs in config or adjust secure rules). I'll include rollback playbook and a rollback window.
sam_netops: RCA plan: 1) confirm exact ALB healthcheck CIDRs (from ALB config) 2) update security hardening checklist to exclude healthcheck ranges or use security-group-for-load-balancer pattern 3) add automated tests in PR pipeline to run a simulated healthcheck against private endpoints.
devex-ops: also recommend adding a runbook entry: how to safely add temporary SG rules and annotate in audit with link to PR/incident.
elaine_prod: I'll follow up with customer and include timeline (RCA + scheduled change next Tuesday) — they want a 24–48h estimate.
jamie_oncall: closing pager — mitigation applied, customer impact mitigated. Next steps in ticket INS-2026-121. Postmortem scheduled (1hr) tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :pray:
olivia: adding logs/commands to the ticket, will attach SG diff and ALB config.
jason_custsuccess: customer acknowledged, appreciated speed of response. Please mark SLO impact and estimate credits if required.
jamie_oncall: noted. assigning SLO calc to @elaine_prod. I will revert the temporary rule only after permanent fix is live and tests pass. timeline in ticket.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — automated reminder to run postmortem in 24h. :calendar:
file_notes: created by incident handoff; contains root + replies; short Slack-style messages
